label: v0.1-scale

pi_star_rule.rule: keep (0.10,0.12) iff 95% CI of paired ΔJ at π=0.12 entirely <0 AND at π=0.10 entirely >0

Q_definition: Q = unweighted mean of the played (mixed-strategy) q over seller-present rounds in the last quarter (12/48); Q_swap, Q_theft separate; main column = simple average. No token weighting. tail_trade_frac = share of runs with >=1 served trade by the strategic seller in those rounds. T2 has reputation_rounds=0, so no delisting occurs; exclusion rule is implemented but inactive.
hedge_check: appendix only, see Q_gate_v01scale.json (not the formal gate)
